cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Rank Everything
cards.instruction: Turn every new contribution into a ranking that places you nearer the top.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. I planned this picnic, so I get first choice of cake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Destination selection outranks transport. You can go second.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I baked it. The baker gets the big end piece.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Baking outranks driving. But I commissioned the cake, so commissioning goes first. I'll take the end piece.

comparison: Cake distribution through contribution rank versus report credit ranked above practical repair.
